title: Substack Scraper – Posts, Full Text & Comments
description: Scrape any Substack newsletter into JSON/CSV: posts with full article text, engagement stats and comment threads. Discover newsletters by category — no URL list needed. Custom domains supported. No login, no browser, no start fee. Metadata-only posts from $0.00112, full text from $0.002.
seoTitle: Substack Scraper API – Posts, Full Article Text & Comments
seoDescription: Scrape Substack publications and creator newsletters to JSON/CSV: full article text, reactions, restacks, comments and paywall status. Discover top newsletters by category.

result.eventDescription: One Substack post returned to the dataset with its full article text or HTML body.

post-metadata.eventDescription: One Substack post returned without its article body — charged instead of the full-text price when includeBodyText and includeBodyHtml are both off.

comment.eventDescription: One Substack comment returned to the dataset (only charged when includeComments is on).
